C0562.title: Courier Convicted for Keeping 380,000+ Yuan of Gifts After False Orders and Main-Item Refusal
C0562.summary: From 2022 to 2024, Beijing courier Sun Mou exploited an e-commerce platform practice of shipping main products and free gifts in separate parcels: he deliberately refused delivery of the main product to trigger a full refund while keeping the gifts, accumulating over 800 gifts with a total market value of more than 380,000 yuan, which he resold on second-hand platforms. The court convicted him of fraud and sentenced him to 2 years and 10 months in prison plus a 20,000 yuan fine; his family fully compensated the victimized company.
